name: Black Ocean
source:
"Oh, wait a minute, i know you!  You are the young lady that adore my special cosmopolitan cocktail!"

The Black Ocean is a rinnomate thematic local, with a great fancy atmosphere. 

There's only a one strange thing about this magical place: 

Some type of customers tending at disappear mysteriously... 

[From [url=https://shinkolartgames.itch.io/black-ocean-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“哦，等一下，我认识你！你就是那位特别喜欢我特调大都会鸡尾酒的年轻小姐！”

“黑色海洋”是一家颇有名气的主题酒吧，环境优雅，气氛迷人。

这个充满魔力的地方，只有一件事有些古怪：

某一类客人，似乎总会神秘失踪…

[摘自[url=https://shinkolartgames.itch.io/black-ocean-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
